rv.q: This delicate and insightful two-hander presents both the playwright and the company at their most skilled.
A Case For The Existence Of God may well be the most intimate and profoundly moving of them all.
The resulting argument is all the more convincing.
A deeply affecting production makes its unrelieved sadness difficult to shake.
Unfortunately, the creative maturation so evident in that play is not immediately apparent in Rogue Machine’s production of A Case for the Existence of God .
I can recommend this show for its superb acting, but I was so frustrated by its conclusion that I’d find it hard to recommend overall.

cn.t: Critics praise Samuel D. Hunter's deeply moving two-hander about unlikely connection between two single fathers, commending the pitch-perfect production, insightful writing, and strong performances in this touching exploration of human nature.
